_meta.schema: slug -> {exam, source, duration_min, negative (marks deducted per wrong answer), marks_per_q, sections[{name, questions, topics{topic:count}, weight_basis}], notes}. Section-level negative / marks_per_q / duration_min override the exam-level values when present.

ssc-cgl-tier-1.source_doc: SSC Notice: Combined Graduate Level Examination 2025 (Scheme of Examination, Tier-I)
ssc-cgl-tier-1.notes: Section question counts, 2 marks/Q, 0.50 negative and 60 min are official (scribe: 80 min). English section is in English only; other sections in English, Hindi and 13 regional languages. Topic weights within sections are estimated from 2024-2025 Tier-1 shifts.

ssc-chsl-tier-1.source_doc: SSC Notice: Combined Higher Secondary (10+2) Level Examination 2025, Tier-I scheme
ssc-chsl-tier-1.notes: Pattern official (4 x 25 Q, 2 marks each, -0.50, 60 min). Topic weights estimated from 2024-2025 Tier-1 papers.

ssc-mts.source_doc: SSC Notice: Multi-Tasking (Non-Technical) Staff and Havaldar (CBIC & CBN) Examination 2025
ssc-mts.notes: Two sessions of 45 min each, both compulsory; 3 marks per question. No negative marking in Session-I; 1 mark deducted per wrong answer in Session-II (section-level 'negative' overrides the top-level value). Havaldar candidates additionally take PET/PST. Topic weights estimated from 2023-2025 papers.

ssc-gd-constable.source_doc: SSC Notice: Constables (GD) in CAPFs, SSF, Rifleman (GD) in Assam Rifles and Sepoy in NCB Examination, 2026

sections.name: English / Hindi
sections.note: Candidate attempts either English or Hindi; 'topics' is the English variant, 'alt_topics.Hindi' the Hindi variant.

ssc-gd-constable.notes: 80 Q x 2 marks, 60 min, 0.25 marks negative per wrong answer (official). Language part: English or Hindi. Topic weights estimated.

ssc-cpo-paper-1.exam: SSC CPO (SI in Delhi Police & CAPFs) Paper 1
ssc-cpo-paper-1.source_doc: SSC Notice: Sub-Inspector in Delhi Police and Central Armed Police Forces Examination 2025
ssc-cpo-paper-1.notes: Paper-I: 4 x 50 Q, 1 mark each, -0.25, 2 hours (official). Topic weights estimated from 2023-2025 papers.

rrb-ntpc-graduate-cbt-1.source_doc: RRB Centralised Employment Notice CEN 06/2025 (NTPC Graduate), Annexure: Scheme of Examination
rrb-ntpc-graduate-cbt-1.notes: 100 Q, 90 min (120 min for PwBD with scribe), 1/3 negative (official). CBT-1 is qualifying/screening. Topic weights estimated from 2024-2025 CBT-1 shifts.

rrb-ntpc-undergraduate-cbt-1.source_doc: RRB Centralised Employment Notice CEN 07/2025 (NTPC Undergraduate), Annexure: Scheme of Examination
rrb-ntpc-undergraduate-cbt-1.notes: Same scheme as Graduate CBT-1; difficulty pitched at 10+2 level. Topic weights estimated.

rrb-group-d.source_doc: RRB Centralised Employment Notice CEN 08/2024 (Level-1), Scheme of CBT

sections.name: General Science
sections.note: Physics, Chemistry, Life Sciences at 10th (CBSE) level

rrb-group-d.notes: Section counts, 90 min, 1/3 negative are official. Topic weights estimated from 2022 and 2025 CBT papers.

rrb-alp-cbt-1.source_doc: RRB Centralised Employment Notice CEN 01/2025 (Assistant Loco Pilot), Scheme of CBT-1

sections.name: Basic Science and Engineering
sections.note: Physics/Chemistry/Biology plus engineering drawing, units, measurement, work-power-energy, heat; mapped to Physics/Chemistry/Biology

rrb-alp-cbt-1.notes: 75 Q, 60 min, 1/3 negative (official). CBT-1 is qualifying. Topic weights estimated.

ibps-po-prelims.negative_rule: 0.25 of the marks assigned to the question
ibps-po-prelims.notes: Official (CRP PO/MT-XVI, 2026): English 30Q/30M, Quant 35Q/30M, Reasoning 35Q/40M, each 20 min separately timed. Marks per question therefore differ by section (section-level marks_per_q overrides top level). Penalty = 1/4 of that question's marks. Topic weights estimated from 2024-2025 prelims.

ibps-clerk-prelims.notes: Official CSA-XV (2025) scheme: 30/35/35 Q, 1 mark each, 20 min per section, -0.25. Numerical & Reasoning offered in English, Hindi and regional languages. CSA-XVI (2026) detailed notification was not found on ibps.in at time of writing; re-check. Topic weights estimated.

sbi-clerk-prelims.source_doc: SBI Advt. CRPD/CR/2025-26/06 (Junior Associates - Customer Support & Sales)
languages: regional languages as per SBI advertisement
sbi-clerk-prelims.notes: 30/35/35 Q, 20 min each, -0.25 per wrong answer per SBI 2025 JA scheme (as reported; the SBI PDF itself could not be fetched, so confirm). Topic weights estimated.

gujarat-police-lrd.source_doc: Gujarat Police Recruitment Board - Lokrakshak cadre recruitment rules/notification (2025 scheme: Part A 80 + Part B 120)

sections.name: The Constitution of India
sections.note: Preamble, FR/DPSP/FD, Union & State executive/legislature/judiciary, Panchayati Raj, constitutional bodies, amendments

gujarat-police-lrd.notes: 200 MCQ, 1 mark each, Part A 80 and Part B 120; minimum 40% required separately in each Part; -0.25 per wrong answer; option 'E' (not attempted) carries no penalty. Duration taken as 3 hours. Section marks per Part are from the GPRB 2025 scheme as reproduced by Gujarati exam portals - the GPRB PDF itself was not retrieved, so confirm. Topic weights estimated from the 2025 LRD paper and earlier GPRB papers.

gsssb-cce-prelims.exam: GSSSB CCE (Class-3 Group A & B) Preliminary
gsssb-cce-prelims.source_doc: GSSSB Advt. No. 212/2023-24 Combined Competitive Examination (Group A & Group B) - Preliminary test scheme
gsssb-cce-prelims.notes: Prelim is qualifying (100 MCQ / 100 marks / 60 min / -0.25), per the 2023-24 CCE scheme; final merit is from Mains (Group A 350 marks descriptive, Group B 200 MCQ). Some secondary sources describe a 150-mark prelim for the next cycle - NOT confirmed from a GSSSB PDF; re-check the next CCE advertisement. Topic weights estimated from the 2024 CCE prelim papers.

gpssb-talati-cum-mantri.exam: GPSSB Talati cum Mantri (Panchayat Secretary) Written
gpssb-talati-cum-mantri.source_doc: GPSSB Advt. No. 10/2021-22 Talati cum Mantri, scheme of written examination (last held 7 May 2023)
gpssb-talati-cum-mantri.notes: Sections 50/20/20/10, 100 marks, 1 hour (GPSSB 2021-22 scheme). -0.25 negative as applied by GPSSB since 2022. Revenue Talati has since moved to GSSSB with a separate prelim+mains scheme, and Panchayat Talati cum Mantri has not been re-advertised; use this blueprint for Panchayat-cadre practice and re-check if GPSSB issues a new advertisement.

up-police-constable.source_doc: UPPRPB Constable Civil Police direct recruitment notification - written exam scheme
up-police-constable.notes: 150 Q x 2 marks = 300, 2 hours, -0.5 per wrong answer (official 2024 scheme; minimum 35% per subject in some cycles). Section counts 38/37/38/37 follow the 2024 exam. Topic weights estimated from Feb & Aug 2024 papers.

delhi-police-constable.source_doc: SSC Notice: Constable (Executive) Male and Female in Delhi Police Examination 2025

sections.name: Computer Fundamentals, MS Excel, MS Word, Communication, Internet, WWW and Web Browsers etc.

delhi-police-constable.notes: 100 Q, 1 mark each, 90 min, -0.25 (official). Topic weights estimated from 2023 and 2025 papers.

bihar-police-constable.source_doc: CSBC Advt. No. 01/2025 Constable recruitment - written exam scheme
bihar-police-constable.notes: Official: 100 MCQ, 100 marks, 2 hours, Matric (10th) standard, subjects Hindi, English, Maths, Social Science, Science, GK & Current Affairs; minimum 30% to qualify; no negative marking. The notification does NOT give per-subject question counts - section counts here are estimated from 2023-2025 papers.

ctet-paper-1.source_doc: CBSE CTET Information Bulletin (Feb 2026 session), Scheme & Syllabus Paper I
languages: Language I/II chosen from the 20 CTET languages

sections.name: Language I
sections.note: Comprehension of unseen prose/poem + language pedagogy

ctet-paper-1.notes: 5 x 30 Q, 1 mark each, 150 min, no negative marking (official). Content/pedagogy and CDP sub-splits are as printed in the CTET syllabus.

ctet-paper-2-maths-science.source_doc: CBSE CTET Information Bulletin (Feb 2026 session), Scheme & Syllabus Paper II
languages: Language I/II chosen from the 20 CTET languages
ctet-paper-2-maths-science.notes: For Maths & Science teachers. Official splits: Maths 30 (20 content + 10 pedagogy), Science 30 (20 + 10). No negative marking.

ctet-paper-2-social-studies.exam: CTET Paper 2 (Classes VI-VIII) - Social Studies/Social Science
ctet-paper-2-social-studies.source_doc: CBSE CTET Information Bulletin (Feb 2026 session), Scheme & Syllabus Paper II
languages: Language I/II chosen from the 20 CTET languages

sections.name: Social Studies/Social Science
sections.note: Official: 40 content + 20 pedagogy; the 40 content split across History/Geography/SPL is estimated.

ctet-paper-2-social-studies.notes: For Social Studies teachers. No negative marking. Content-vs-pedagogy (40/20) is official; sub-split of content estimated.

upsc-cse-prelims-gs-1.exam: UPSC CSE Prelims GS Paper I
upsc-cse-prelims-gs-1.source_doc: UPSC Civil Services (Preliminary) Examination 2026 Notice, Appendix I (Scheme & Syllabus)
upsc-cse-prelims-gs-1.notes: 100 Q, 200 marks, 2 hours, 1/3 of the question's marks (0.66) deducted per wrong answer (official). GS-II (CSAT) is qualifying at 33% and is not covered here. Topic weights estimated from 2022-2025 papers.

state-psc-prelims-generic.notes: Generic template - no single official source. Approximates GPSC/UPPSC/BPSC/RPSC/MPPSC GS papers (150 Q common; GPSC uses 200 marks over 2 papers, UPPSC 150 Q/200 marks with CSAT, BPSC 150 Q with 1/3 negative). Adjust per commission. 'State GK' should be expanded to that state's history/geography/culture.
